intent.idea: A silent comedy about a character trying to catch its runaway shadow
intent.audience: people scrolling short vertical video on a phone
intent.intended_effect: laughter at a clever, character-driven payoff

premise.title: The Copycat
premise.opening_image: A small round creature in a long red stocking cap walks onto a meadow at sunset; its long shadow walks with it across the grass toward us.
premise.audience_hook: Why is the shadow a beat late, and what will it do next?
premise.central_action: The shadow peels itself off the ground, stands up as a dark twin with white eyes, blows a raspberry and runs off; the creature chases it into the long shadow of a tree, where it hides.
premise.complication: Chasing fails: the shadow can melt into any darker shadow, and the creature's hat-net dive ends face-first in the grass while two white eyes giggle from the tree's shade.
premise.payoff: The creature stops chasing and starts a goofy dance; the shadow cannot resist copying, slides out of hiding mid-dance, and the creature stomps on its feet to pin it back in place. Then the sun sets, every shadow vanishes, and two white eyes wink up from the dark.

intent.logline: A small creature's shadow runs off at sunset; three stomps can't pin it down, so the creature dances until the copycat shadow copies its way under its feet for the fourth.
intent.opening_promise: Pim walks onto a sunset meadow and stops to enjoy the view; its long shadow copies every move, one beat late.
intent.ending: The sun sets, the meadow goes dark and the shadow vanishes with the light; Pim looks down, worried, and two white eyes open on the dark grass beside its feet and wink.
intent.style: Flat bold cartoon: solid shapes, 7-unit dark plum outlines, no gradients on characters, a backlit sunset sky graded from violet to gold.

audio_intent.music: original note-list score (pizzicato, marimba, celesta) synthesised in code
audio_intent.sfx: seeded procedural sound design placed on the picture's moment table

shot_plan.purpose: establish Pim, the meadow and a shadow that copies
shot_plan.sees: Pim walks in and stops to sigh at the sunset; the long shadow on the grass walks and sighs with it

shot_plan.purpose: reveal the shadow has a mind of its own
shot_plan.sees: Pim stretches; the shadow holds the stretch after Pim stops, adds an extra flourish, then snaps innocent when Pim double-takes
Pim leans in to squint; the shadow slides away from Pim's feet, hinges up into a dark twin with white eyes, blows a raspberry and sprints off, leaving Pim with no shadow at all

shot_plan.purpose: force fails, and plants the stomp
shot_plan.sees: the twin drops flat on the grass; Pim stomps at it three times and it slides away each time, the third time into the tree's long shade where it vanishes; two white eyes giggle from the shade while Pim hops on a sore foot
Pim gets an idea and dances in the sunlight; the shadow cannot resist copying, slides out of the shade copying the dance and creeps under Pim's feet; the fourth stomp lands and it snaps back attached

shot_plan.purpose: button: the shadow gets the last word
shot_plan.sees: the sun sinks, the light and every shadow fade, Pim looks down worried, and two white eyes open in the dark grass by its feet and wink

hardest_shot.why: The shadow must read as Pim's own projection, then visibly detach, hinge up into a standing twin and run, while Pim's feet are left without a shadow; if the detach or the stand-up reads as a sticker swap the premise fails.
hardest_shot.fallback: Stage the escape as the flat shadow sliding away along the grass without standing up, and keep the dark twin for the chase only.

instructions: You are an independent reviewer for a short vertical film made in Motif Atelier. You did not make it. Judge only the rendered evidence listed here against the stated intent: do not read the project source, builder notes or earlier reviews. Be specific and critical; a polite PASS on weak work defeats the purpose. For every dimension give PASS, FAIL or NOT_ASSESSED with a one-sentence note citing times or frames. Use NOT_ASSESSED whenever the evidence cannot establish the dimension (for example motion smoothness between sampled frames, or how the mix sounds). NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only for the dimensions listed under not_applicable, with that reason. List every problem that should block release as a critical issue with the smallest fix.
